title: Executive Development Program in Strategic HR Leadership
seo_title: Strategic HR Leadership Program XLRI | Accredian
description: Embark on a 10 month learning journey in HRM Strategy, DEI Leadership, and GenAI.

content.title: who should join
points: HR Professionals: Transition into strategic roles and decision-making.
Business Leaders: Align HR strategies with organizational goals.
Mid-Level Practitioners: Broaden expertise in workforce planning and analytics.
HR Consultants: Deepen knowledge of strategic HR practices.
Cross-Functional Leaders: Collaborate effectively with HR on organizational strategy.
Founders: Develop robust HR strategies for scalability.

content.title: program snapshot
points: 8 Modules - HRM Strategy, DEI Leadership, and GenAI
Learn from the top industry professionals and expert sessions by XLRI Faculty
Campus Immersions: One Campus Immersion of 2 days

curriculum.title: Future of the workplace - Introduction to new-age HRM
points: Setting the context for digital change in HR
Developing an ability to look into the future
Impact of organizational design on strategy
Managing Organisation Culture in Hybrid Workmode - Challenges and Strategies

curriculum.title: Strategic HRM
points: Talent management: attraction, retention, and development
Aligning business strategy with organization objectives (SHRM frameworks)
Role of HR in successful mergers, acquisitions and joint ventures

curriculum.title: Understanding HR Metrics
points: Framework for Problem Solving - Define Problem, Collect Data, Build the model, Evaluate and Critique the model, Present Results and Benefits, Deploy Model
Steps to workforce planning - supply, demand, gap and solution analysis (Markov chain, scatter plot, trend analysis)

curriculum.title: Digitalization, AI and HRM
points: Behavioral Modeling and Predictive analytics - Case Discussion
GenAI and its applications in HR strategy & planning and Recruitment & Selection

curriculum.title: Leadership Excellence & People Development
points: Building Leadership through uncertain times; Leadership and communication
Performance management and appraisal for the next-generation employees
Employee counselling, coaching, and mentoring for leadership development

curriculum.title: Strategy and Leadership for Senior HR Professionals
points: External environment and its implications for HR and Leadership
Innovation and its implication for the organization – people, structure, culture
Role of HR as a Business Growth Enabler
Understanding the business landscape – competitive advantage, supply demand, value chain, product positioning
Role of leadership in start-ups – scaling challenges, matching internal scaling with external scaling

curriculum.title: DEI, Employee wellness and Compensation Management
points: Understanding and managing stress in the workplace
Diversity: Relevance in the present time and context

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: The capstone project for the Strategic HR Leadership Program enables participants to apply their knowledge by addressing a complex, real-world business challenge.

It requires strategic analysis, decision-making, and leadership skills cultivated throughout the program, offering a hands-on opportunity to synthesize learning and demonstrate their expertise in driving impactful solutions to organizational issues.
Includes a live Capstone Project Discussion session (virtual).

content.title: Is prior experience in HR required for program enrollment?
content: This program is specifically crafted for seasoned professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with substantial industry experience.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: ## Minimum System Requirements for the Program:
- **Processor**: Any modern processor – Intel Core i3 (10th Gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 3 (3000 series or newer) / Apple M1 or later

content.title: How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: In the Strategic HR Leadership Program, you will work on real-world case studies and Capstone Projects to gain a better understanding of the practical applications of strategic HR and leadership concepts.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 10 months.

content.title: How's the Executive Development Program in Strategic HR Leadership program different?
content: ### Three things that make this program world class
- **Progressive Learning Architecture:** XLRI's proprietary Progressive Learning Architecture ensures that irrespective of the background you are from, you will attain mastery in a step-by-step way.
- **Theory to Industry Learning Framework:** XLRI's Theory to Industry framework ensures that you are learning every HR Leadership concept in context of real-world industry problems.
- **Accredian Career Center:**  Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
